findings.claim: The ratchet protocol is not coherent as a monotone gate: its tightness decays and its only enforcing mode is unwired. `verify:package` invokes the script with no flags, so the release path always runs later-coordinate mode, where `candidate > datum` throws but a SHRINK passes silently and never rebinds the datum down — headroom accumulates monotonically. The exact-equality arm (`--first-adoption`) is invoked by no npm script and no workflow; it exists only as a public-surface fixture. And the ⊕¹⁶ rebind protocol ("the datum rebinds only at an owner-worded component addition, in a commit that names the delta — never silently, never by a verify seat") is prose only: `.bundle-ratchet` is a plain 7-byte file with zero executable guard on who may raise it, so nothing in the repo can distinguish an owner-worded rebind from a silent one. Separately, the ⊕¹⁶ claim that the 5,056-byte delta is "exactly music-staff's 7 packed members" is an attribution, not a measurement: the datum is a GZIP tarball size, whose delta is not the additive sum of member bytes.
findings.provenance: scripts/verify-export-types.mjs:726-750 (ratchetEvidence) :835-843 (argv parsing) · package.json:526 (`"verify:package": "node scripts/verify-export-types.mjs"`, no flags) · .bundle-ratchet (7 bytes, `903382\n`) · docs/tranches/BK/EXECUTION-PROGRESS.md:175-177 (⊕¹⁶)

Code read of :739 — `if (!firstAdoption && candidate > datum) throw` — no lower bound in the wired mode. `git log --oneline -- .bundle-ratchet` → two commits ever (147a0bf9, dcc041cb); no test, script, or hook references the file outside ratchetEvidence. Arithmetic check: 903382 − 898326 = 5056 ✓ (the number is right; the causal attribution to 7 uncompressed members is unverifiable from a gzip size).
findings.cure: Either wire `--first-adoption` into `verify:package` at ship-time (making the exact-equality arm real) or add a lower-bound arm so a shrink forces a rebind-down; and make the rebind protocol executable — e.g. require the rebind commit to touch `.bundle-ratchet` alone with an owner mark, checked by a gate — or retire the ratchet's "monotone" framing in the cursor to what it actually is: a hand-maintained byte budget.

findings.claim: The one-pair specular collapse changed the ACCENT channel's alpha law, and the banked seal captures never exercise it. Baking the layer alpha into the cream endpoint (`hsl(40 35% 92% / 0.55)`) and mixing it against a typically-OPAQUE `--glass-accent` means premultiplied oklab interpolation makes the layer's alpha drift with `--glass-accent-strength`. Pre-cure the alpha was pinned by per-stop `color-mix(in srgb, <core> N%, transparent)` and was invariant under accent. Separately, the radial disc's rest alpha moved 0.50 → 0.55 (the conic and disc had different per-stop alphas; they are now both the core's 0.55), so the commit's 'byte-identical at rest' framing is not exact for the disc.
findings.provenance: src/styles/glass/material.css:200-209 (the collapsed core + the byte-identical claim), :215-227 (both gradients now reading the bare core); the pre-cure per-stop alphas at cfc4dffa^:src/styles/glass/material.css (`color-mix(in srgb, var(--glass-specular-core) 55%, transparent)` / `… 50%, transparent`); opaque accent writers: src/components/card/Card.vue:47 with src/components/card/styles.css:88-94 (16%/28%), src/styles/utilities/metal.css:217-218 (`--glass-accent: var(--color-gold); --glass-accent-strength: 45%`); shipped demo opaque hue: demo/stories/display/card.vue:66 `data-hue="oklch(0.72 0.14 78)"`
findings.proof: `git show cfc4dffa -- src/styles/glass/material.css` shows the per-stop `color-mix(… 55%/50%, transparent)` wrappers deleted and the endpoints replaced by bare `var(--glass-specular-core)`. Under CSS Color 4/5 premultiplied interpolation, `color-mix(in oklab, cream/0.55, accent/1.0 P)` has alpha `0.55*(1-P) + 1.0*P`: at the shipped selected-card 28% that is 0.676 (disc 0.50 → 0.676, +35%; conic 0.55 → 0.676, +23%); at metal-rainbow-rim's 45% it is 0.7525. The transparent-accent case is unchanged (0.55*(1-P) both before and after), so the drift is exactly the opaque-accent case the API is FOR. The seal cells in docs/tranches/BK/execution/2026-08-03-audit-visual/CAPTURE-RECORD.md are dock capsules / story card / rail at rest+hover — no `data-hue` surface, no metal specimen: the accent channel of the collapsed pair has zero paint evidence.
findings.cure: Restore an accent-invariant alpha — keep the core opaque and re-introduce the layer alpha as a gradient-stop `/ 0.55` on a non-color-mix ink, or multiply the layer `opacity`. Then bank ONE capture of a `data-hue` Card at 28% (light+dark, hover) before the row seals.

The overshoot that matters: de-nesting morph.css deleted a mathematically exact single-declaration lerp and replaced it with two stacked complementary-opacity layers plus a NEW aria-hidden DOM node — a composite of a+b−ab, so the dock plate thins 9.4% at t=0.5 on every morph (dock.css:104/:123, GlassDock.vue:336, all introduced by cfc4dffa). The same commit's de-tint made the flat rungs that would have permitted the correct one-layer fix pass-1 §12 actually ordered. That defect is precisely what the ordered mid-morph capture would have seen — and it was not taken: 144aa196's subject says 'the row-6 seal precondition is CAPTURED' while CAPTURE-RECORD.md:12 says the frame is uncapturable and substitutes a WIDTH trace, which cannot see a plate-alpha sag. Undershoots: --glass-bg-sheet is now an orphan token with two comments still claiming a live consumer and an oklab wrapper the same commit deleted; the specular flattening lifted the radial disc 0.50→0.55 and made gleam alpha accent-coupled (0.55→0.7525 at metal's shipped 45%) under a false 'byte-identical' comment; FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR rewired 2 of the 4 named lists (DataTable, useDockClickIntegrity, ExpandableContainer:167 still divergent) and the ordered fullEl focus fallback was skipped; the row's own gate G-WK-COLORMIX-BUDGET has no detector on disk and the new test's four-file resolved arm leaves 51 resolved-nested endpoints unasserted, ladder.css's 9 among them — pass-1 §13's disjunction was taken neither way, and the header's 'one graph deep' is false (21 multi-hop).
